import base64,hashlib,json,os,resource,sys,zlib
from pathlib import Path
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(2,2))
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{min(os.sched_getaffinity(0))})
target=Path(TARGET); payload=json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(PAYLOAD,validate=True))); expected=json.loads(EXPECTED)
if set(payload)!=set(expected):raise ValueError('"'"'unexpected payload files'"'"')
if sum(len(x.encode()) for x in payload.values())>1000000:raise ValueError('"'"'total cap'"'"')
for name,data in payload.items():
 b=data.encode();
 if len(b)>1000000 or [len(b),hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()]!=expected[name]:raise ValueError('"'"'input SHA or size'"'"')
target.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=False)
for name,data in payload.items():
 f=target/name
 with f.open('"'"'xb'"'"') as o:o.write(data.encode());o.flush();os.fsync(o.fileno())
 f.chmod(0o444)
manifest=json.dumps({'"'"'files'"'"':expected,'"'"'scope'"'"':'"'"'CPU preflight prerequisites; no GPU authorization'"'"'},sort_keys=True,indent=2).encode()+b'"'"'\n'"'"'
with (target/'"'"'manifest.json'"'"').open('"'"'xb'"'"') as o:o.write(manifest);o.flush();os.fsync(o.fileno())
(target/'"'"'manifest.json'"'"').chmod(0o444)
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:os.execv('"'"'/usr/bin/python3'"'"',['"'"'/usr/bin/python3'"'"','"'"'-I'"'"','"'"'-S'"'"','"'"'-B'"'"','"'"'-c'"'"',AUDIT,str(target),EXPECTED])
